info.title: Sim API v2 — Billing
info.description: Version 2 of the Sim REST API for billing standing, credit allowance, storage quota, and cursor-paginated usage history.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Inspect billing standing, credit allowance, storage quota, and usage history.

get.description:
Get the current plan, billing standing, credit allowance, and storage quota. Pooled `credits` and `storage` are visible only to callers who can manage the payer's billing; workspace API keys receive null for both. Use List Billing Logs for credit history.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace whose payer should be resolved. A workspace API key is pinned to its own workspace: any other id answers `404 Workspace not found`, which is also what an id that does not exist answers.

schema.description: Workspace whose payer should be resolved. A workspace API key is pinned to its own workspace: any other id answers `404 Workspace not found`, which is also what an id that does not exist answers.

200.description: The current billing and storage status.

get.description:
List credit usage with source filtering and cursor pagination. The default `period` is `30d`; pagination covers only the selected time window. An inverted custom window returns `400`.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Restrict results to one usage source.

schema.description: Restrict results to one usage source.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Narrow the ledger to one workspace. An OAuth token or personal API key reports only its user's events; a workspace API key reports every member's events in its bound workspace. The response `scope` identifies which view was returned. A workspace key asking for another workspace receives the same `404 Workspace not found` as an unknown id.

schema.description: Narrow the ledger to one workspace. An OAuth token or personal API key reports only its user's events; a workspace API key reports every member's events in its bound workspace. The response `scope` identifies which view was returned. A workspace key asking for another workspace receives the same `404 Workspace not found` as an unknown id.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Relative window, all history, or a custom date range. `startDate` and `endDate` are accepted only with `custom`; every other value computes its own window.

schema.description: Relative window, all history, or a custom date range. `startDate` and `endDate` are accepted only with `custom`; every other value computes its own window.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Only include usage events recorded at or after this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. `2026-08-06T00:00:00Z`. Requires `period=custom`. A date without a time, or a timestamp carrying a UTC offset instead of `Z`, is rejected, as is year `0000`, which names no storable instant.

schema.description: Only include usage events recorded at or after this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. `2026-08-06T00:00:00Z`. Requires `period=custom`. A date without a time, or a timestamp carrying a UTC offset instead of `Z`, is rejected, as is year `0000`, which names no storable instant.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Only include usage events recorded at or before this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. `2026-08-06T00:00:00Z`. Requires `period=custom`, and defaults to now when omitted. A date without a time, or a timestamp carrying a UTC offset instead of `Z`, is rejected, as is year `0000`, which names no storable instant.

schema.description: Only include usage events recorded at or before this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. `2026-08-06T00:00:00Z`. Requires `period=custom`, and defaults to now when omitted. A date without a time, or a timestamp carrying a UTC offset instead of `Z`, is rejected, as is year `0000`, which names no storable instant.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum usage events per page. Must be a whole number from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

schema.description: Maximum usage events per page. Must be a whole number from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Send it back with the same sort and filters; only `limit` may change. Change anything else and pagination must restart without a cursor.

schema.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Send it back with the same sort and filters; only `limit` may change. Change anything else and pagination must restart without a cursor.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Your Sim API key, personal or workspace-scoped. Generate one under Settings, then API Keys. Operations that reject workspace keys say so in their own description.

oauthBearer.description: A Sim OAuth access token obtained by a registered client through the authorization-code flow. Each operation declares its required scope: api:read permits reads and searches; api:write also permits changes and execution and implies api:read. Scope requirements follow the application operation, independent of HTTP method or workspace role.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window.

schema.title: Rate limit
schema.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

schema.title: Rate limit remaining
schema.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the current rate-limit window resets.

schema.title: Rate limit reset
schema.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the current rate-limit window resets.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, sent on `429` and `503`. Add jitter rather than retrying at exactly this offset.

schema.title: Retry after
schema.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, sent on `429` and `503`. Add jitter rather than retrying at exactly this offset.

X-Run-Id.description: Identifier assigned to the workflow run.

schema.title: Run identifier
schema.description: Identifier assigned to the workflow run.

BadRequest.description: The request is invalid. This includes a query parameter sent with no value (`?limit=`, `?search=`), which is rejected rather than read as zero, empty, or the parameter default — omit the parameter instead.

Unauthorized.description: The API credential is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the rights this operation requires. When the cause is one a caller can act on, `error.details.code` names it. A resource in a workspace the caller cannot reach at all answers `404` instead, so absence and denial are indistinguishable.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

RateLimited.description: The caller exceeded the request rate limit.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable. `Retry-After` carries the seconds to wait; treat it as a floor and add jitter. The header is omitted when `error.details.code` is `ASYNC_ENQUEUE_AMBIGUOUS`, because the run may already have started — reconcile against the returned run id instead of retrying.

V2ActionableForbiddenDetails.title: Actionable forbidden details
V2ActionableForbiddenDetails.description: Machine-readable cause and optional context for an actionable `403` response.

V2ForbiddenDetailCode.title: Forbidden detail code
V2ForbiddenDetailCode.description: Stable cause code for an actionable `403` response.

details.description: Structured error context whose keys depend on the error. Actionable `403` responses use the `V2ActionableForbiddenDetails` shape; validation failures may return issue arrays instead.

anyOf.description: Other structured context defined by the specific error.

V2Error.title: v2 error response
V2Error.description: Canonical error envelope returned by the public v2 API.

workspaceId.description: Workspace whose payer was resolved, or null for account billing.

start.description: ISO 8601 start of the current billing period, or 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z when no Stripe subscription defines one.

end.description: ISO 8601 end of the current billing period, or 9999-12-31T00:00:00.000Z when no Stripe subscription defines one.

period.description: Current billing period. Only a Stripe subscription defines a real period; without one — notably on the free plan — this is the open interval 1970-01-01 to 9999-12-31 and must not be read as a monthly window.

used.description: Credits consumed so far. The counter is reset by Stripe invoice webhooks, so on a paid plan it covers the current billing period; on the free plan nothing resets it and the value is lifetime consumption.

limit.description: Credit allowance for the reporting window — per billing period on a paid plan, lifetime on the free plan.

remaining.description: Allowance minus consumption, over the same window.

credits.description: The payer's credit usage and allowance — periodic on a paid plan, lifetime on the free plan, where the counter never resets. Null when the caller cannot manage that payer's billing. Always null for a workspace API key.

percentUsed.description: Percentage of the storage quota consumed.

storage.description: The payer's storage consumption and quota, or null when the caller cannot manage that payer's billing. Always null for a workspace API key.

V2BillingStatus.title: Billing status
V2BillingStatus.description: Current billing standing, credit allowance, and storage quota.

V2BillingStatusResponse.title: Billing status response
V2BillingStatusResponse.description: Current billing standing, credit allowance, and storage quota.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the usage event was recorded.

source.description: Product surface that consumed the credits.

workspaceId.description: Workspace attributed to the event, or null for account-level usage.

workflow.description: Workflow attributed to the event, when applicable.

runId.description: Workflow run attributed to the event, when applicable.

creditCost.description: Credits apportioned to the event so page rows sum to the rounded page total; may be zero for a sub-credit event.

V2BillingLogEntry.title: Billing log entry
V2BillingLogEntry.description: One credit-consuming usage event in the billing ledger.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Send it back as `cursor`; `null` means there is nothing further to fetch. Never construct one yourself.

scope.description: Whose usage this page reports. `user` contains only the OAuth or personal-key user's events, optionally narrowed by `workspaceId`; it omits other members. `workspace` contains every member's events for the workspace API key's bound workspace.

V2BillingLogListResponse.title: Billing log list response
V2BillingLogListResponse.description: A cursor-paginated page of credit-consuming usage events.
